answer: A payout is split so that 54% arrives at settlement and the rest over 11 epochs, and any slash during the tail cancels the remainder. The grove schedule is applied in ember and timber makes public each instalment. An hostile operator hence cannot take the money and run, since most of the value is still exposed when the audit lands. A farm of 4931 identities would post 1766 proofs and burn roughly 36 thousand dollars in locked value before a single vote counted. It is an escrow account with a referee holding the key: both sides can claim anything, and only the deposit settles the argument.
